config.stage: Posthoc development; all input waveforms previously exposed
config.holding_interpretation: Chronological blocks, not confirmed stored-TP holding-voltage groups
config.effective_filter: Two identical cascaded first-order low-pass stages, common to all channels
config.coefficient_constraints: Signed per-channel exponential coefficients; reciprocity and passivity not imposed
config.noise_scale: Mean training baseline sample SD per channel, floored at 1 pA
config.selection: Smallest mode count with whitened onset residual <=1.25*RMS(training difference/2); else minimum onset residual as diagnostic only
config.response_gate: Each evaluated waveform: joint RMSE/noise<=2, maximum channel RMSE/noise<=3, RMSE/zero<=0.2, for onset and offset separately
config.derivative_mode_proxy: 0.1 ms averages; first differences between onset bins 2..97; signal=training mean, variability=(train0-train1)/2
config.reproducible_mode_rule: Signal singular value >3*largest variability singular value; descriptive threshold, not a confidence interval

mode_proxy.interpretation: Repeat-stable finite-difference modes; not intrinsic membrane rank or a statistical confidence bound

interpretation: Descriptive prediction and observability checks under an uncalibrated effective filter; no intrinsic circuit or spatial metric fit
limitations: All waveforms had been exposed before this development specification
